text: 【新年快樂】Hello 各位女士們很高興再次見到你們今天我們將繼續討論請把你的學生書和工作圖準備好希望在課程結束後你們將達到目標今天我們將讀一篇文章請打開你的學生書轉到14個頁面看看題目介紹和圖片然後回答問題圖片中的誰是誰?【圖片中的誰是誰?你們有答案嗎?他們是Jason、Mandy和AnnaJason和Mandy在做什麼?They are using the internet to look for pen friendsThey are reading Anna's blogHow can you tell Jason and Mandy are using the internet to look for pen friends?Can you find the clues from the pictures?First, Jason and Mandy are using the internet to look for pen friendsFirst, Jason and Mandy are watching the computer screenSecond, the picture of Anna and her article are on the computer screenThird, the introduction is on a website of pen friend indexThis picture is an envelope with the word pen friends and two hands togetherSo, I think maybe Jason and Mandy are looking for pen friends from this pen friend websiteJason and Mandy are reading Anna's blogThen, what is the blog?Let's watch a video clip and find outBlogsBlogs are websites that allow people to share their thoughts and writingBlogs are like online journals or diariesThey are written in different languagesBlogs are written in different languagesBlogs are like online journals or diariesThey are really awesomeBlogs can be written by anyoneBut, blogs usually aren't privateSo remember, your blog posts can be seen by everyoneYour comments can tooKeep comments positiveAnd encouragingWhen you get blogging a tryHave funNow, do you know what a blog modus operandi goal?你找到答案了嗎?讓我們來看看主要關於什麼?這是安娜的自我介紹安娜的自我介紹安娜的自我介紹安娜的自我介紹安娜的自我介紹安娜的自我介紹為什麼她會寫這篇文章?因為她想要從世界各地來得到朋友在John的文章中他把自己的照片和一些他的好朋友關閉為了讓我知道他長什麼樣子安娜不能把她的照片關閉在她的文章中為什麼她會讓別人知道她長什麼樣子?她在她的文章中展示了她的照片她在每個文章中寫了什麼?她在一篇文章中寫了她自己她在二篇文章中寫了她的喜好她在三篇文章中寫了她的家庭她在四篇文章中寫了她的學業和目標她在五篇文章中寫了她的目標她在最後一篇文章中寫了她的目標她在最後一篇文章中寫了她的目標寫博客的目的請重新讀安娜的文章再找到安娜的詳細資訊然後完成桌子這是你的工作址的第一項目標你完成了嗎?讓我們檢查一下什麼是她的喜愛?Anna likes sports.She loves playing badminton, swimming and playing tennis.She likes pop music and is learning to play the guitar.She enjoys reading and speaking English.What about her home and family, school and ambition?She lives in a flat close to the mountains.How many brothers and sisters does she have?She has three sisters and one brother.Her favorite subjects are math, art and English.What does she want to be?She wants to be an architect.Now we've got a lot of information about Anna.Read Jason's information.Find out the similarities and differences between Jason and Anna.Boys and girls, we can use a Venn diagram to find out the similarities and differences.How to use a Venn diagram?You can put similarities of theirs into the overlapping sectionand put differences of theirs into the rest of the section of each circle.For example, Jason likes sports, Anna also likes sports.Liking sports is their similarity.So we write this in the overlapping section.Jason doesn't like music, while Anna likes pop music and is learning to play the guitar.These are their differences.So we put their differences into their own circle, but not the overlapping section.Have you understood how to use the Venn diagram to find out the similarities and differences between Jason and Anna?Let's have a try.Read their information and complete the diagram.It's task two on your worksheet.Boys and girls, we can use a Venn diagram to find out the similarities and differences between Jason and Anna.Read Jason's information and complete the diagram.Have you finished your diagram?Let's share.Nina, can you introduce their similarities and differences?From the diagram, we can know clearly Jason and Anna have many things in common.They both like sports and they both like English.Their favorite subjects are both math and English, both of them live in flats.Speaking of the differences, Jason doesn't like music, but Anna does.Jason has no brothers or sisters, but Anna does.Jason wants to be a PE teacher, while Anna would like to be an architect.Well done, Nina.You clearly know about their similarities and differences.From the diagram, we can know Jason and Anna share some same hobbies.They are both good at math and English.Their living environment is alike, but they do have some differences such as family members and ambitions.What kind of pen friend does Jason want?He wants a pen friend in Europe or Australia.So can Anna probably be Jason's pen friend?Because Anna lives in Germany, and Germany is a European country.Do you think Jason will write to Anna?Or why not?Please think about the questions.What's your opinion boys and girls?Let's share some of my students' ideas.I think Jason will write to Anna because both of them enjoy learning English and their favorite subjects are the same.They are English and math.Jason and Anna will have many topics to talk about.I think they can discuss how to solve some difficult math problems in their letters.I don't think Jason will write to Anna because they are so much alike.They are both sports fans.English and math are their favorite subjects.Jason will probably think her life is almost the same as his, and he wants to know someone different from him.Your ideas both sound reasonable.We are done.What about Mandy?Do you think she will write to Anna?Please use a Venn diagram to find out the similarities and differences between Mandy and Anna.Then think about the two questions.It's task 3 on your worksheet.Have you finished?Jeff, what are their similarities?They both like pop music and playing musical instruments.They have the same favorite subject, English.They both like reading English.What about their differences?Their differences are as follows.Mandy hates sports while Anna is a sports fan.Mandy lives in a house in the countryside while Anna lives in a flat close to the mountains.And Mandy wants to be a nurse while Anna would like to be an architect.So they have different living environments and ambitions.Do you think Mandy will write to Anna?Jeff, what's your opinion?I don't think Mandy will write to Anna because Mandy hates sports while Anna likes sports.Besides, their living places are quite different.Mandy will probably think they have different living styles.Maybe they have few topics to talk about.What's your opinion Nina?I don't agree with Jeff because they live in different places.Mandy will probably be interested in the life near the mountains.Maybe Mandy will think living near the mountains is really amazing.She is looking forward to knowing about how the life there is.Excellent!Where's and goes?Think about it.What aspects do people usually think about when choosing pen friends?People usually think about their age, hobbies, families, jobs and so on.Why do they think about these aspects?Because these are the common topics in our daily life.And it's easy to begin with.In fact, we usually like to make pen friends who are similar to ourselves.Because the more things we have in common, the more topics we can share with each other.But if we want to learn something we don't know, to choose a pen friend who is very different from us is also a good choice.In a word, choosing what kind of person as your pen friend depends on your needs.We know Anna would like to have pen friends from all over the world.Would you like to be her pen friend?Why or why not?Would you like to be Anna's pen friend?I don't want to be her pen friend because I hate sports.I am a quiet girl and I prefer staying at home to going outside.Of course, I am poor at sports.800m race is my nightmare.Maybe she is outgoing.We are quite different from each other.We probably don't have to be friends.You can share with your classmates and teachers.Don't forget your homework.This is the end of today's class.See you next time.Good night.
